summary: America Movil filed a Form 6-K announcing the filing of its annual report (20-F equivalent) for fiscal year ended Dec 31, 2025 with the SEC, CNBV, and BMV. No transaction, event, or special situation is described. The filing is a routine regulatory disclosure of an annual report, not a special situation. No deal terms, board actions, or event-driven dynamics exist. The filing is only an notice of availability of financial statements.
